title: Ephéméride des luttes : 4 octobre
content:
Le 4 octobre, l'éphéméride des luttes détruit des chantiers de centrale nucléaire et s'organise radicalement contre les fascistes. Ce qui serait aussi intéressant de reproduire aujourd'hui.


1884 :

 A Chicago, parution du premier numéro du journal anarchiste '

The Alarm

'.


1893 :

 Naissance près de Milan de Francesco Ghezzi, qui mourra dans les camps de travail en Russie. Voir l'éphéméride anarchiste pour une biographie détaillée (lien en bas).


1905 :

 A Ekaterinoslav en Russie, le Groupe d'Ouvriers Anarchistes-Communistes pose une bombe dans la maison du directeur et actionnaire de l'usine Construction de Machines à Amur, qui avait fait licencier 3000 ouvriers. Lire

le communiqué

 en français.


1930 :

 Au Brésil, début de la Révolution avec la prise du quartier général de la 3e Région Militaire.


1957 :

 Premier satellite artificiel lancé dans l'espace. C'est le Spoutnik russe.


1971 :

 A Belfast, un soldat de l'armée britannique est tué par une bombe de l'IRA 'Officielle' (OIRA).


1977 :

 A Rome, une assemblée autonome décide de continuer à mener une campagne d'actions dures contre les fascistes, dans la continuité de ce qui avait été fait les jours précédents.


1981 :

 Une manifestation de 4000 personnes envahit le site de la centrale nucléaire de Golfech en construction, provoquant beaucoup de dégâts dans le chantier, le retardant de fait pour un bon moment. Pendant 4 à 5 heures, jusqu'à la tombée de la nuit, des affrontements (grenades lacrymogènes d'un côté, jets de pierres ou de cocktails molotov de l'autre) ont lieu. Selon

Courant Alternatif

 de novembre 1981 (extrait reproduit

ici

), «

Des centaines de mètres de barbelés arrachés et de nombreuses installations attaquées et incendiées, partiellement ou totalement détruites : plusieurs hangars, des engins de travaux, un poste de vigiles, les bureaux d'une agence d'intérim, le local d'EDF (bureau d'information situé le long de la RN113) ainsi que celui de l'ANPE.


Les dégâts sur le site sont conséquents

 ».


 Attaque de la prison de Frosinone, en Italie, par les COLP (Communistes Organisés pour la Libération du Prolétariat), afin de faire évader le militant des Prolétaires Armés pour le Communisme (PAC) Cesare Battisti. L'évasion réussira sans que personne ne soit blessé.


1993 :

 Dans le nord de Londres, l'IRA fait sauter cinq bombes.


2016 :

 A Munich, un véhicule de l'entreprise de sécurité privée VDH, qui travaille dans les camps pour migrants et fait ses profits avec l'enfermement, le harcèlement et le contrôle,

est incendié

 en solidarité avec les luttes des migrant-e-s.


2018 :

 A Clermont-Ferrand, à trois heures du matin, le local néofasciste du Bastion Social est la cible d'une tentative d'incendie, peu de temps après avoir déjà été saccagé par des antifascistes.

author: David Swanson
title: Which Way Is Peace?
content:
By David Swanson, World BEYOND War, October 3, 2026


Remarks in Baltimore on October 3, 2026, at event with

War Is Still A Lie


Thank you to Ronda Cooperstein and the local chapter of World BEYOND War for setting this event up.


I recently read a big stack of books on the decline and elimination of dueling. There were thousands of factors, many of them beyond anyone’s easy control, but key among them was cultural change, was bringing people to find greater humiliation in dueling than in not dueling, greater respect in refusing to duel than in being willing to duel. The picture of dueling as noble, respectable, and courageous was replaced by one much nearer the truth: drunken primadonnas misperceiving insults and committing murder for lack of the ability to admit they were idiots. And dueling died by stages. More and more would-be duelists’ so-called seconds negotiated peace. More and more duels ended without deaths or injuries, often with bullets intentionally shot into the air. More and more duelists were prosecuted for the crime. More and more newspaper cartoonists depicted duelists as monkeys and clowns. Dueling was outlawed and denounced for centuries before the abolitionists finally succeeded.


War has been outlawed for a century and denounced for longer than that, and for a while now it’s been wounded. If Teddy Roosevelt came back to life in some museum and declared that we needed some more wars just for the fun of it, he wouldn’t get far. No longer can anyone get majorities to believe that wars are desirable or good because they build character or are simply one acceptable tool of foreign relations or are needed to spread somebody’s religion or race or empire. Every war is depicted as the last possible resort, no matter how absurdly or how much effort has gone into creating the war and preventing its resolution.


War, like dueling, is an exception. Most people never dueled. In most parts of the world there is no war. Most people would have done anything they could to avoid dueling and most do everything that can to avoid war — even those who support other people going to war. But we haven’t yet gotten to the point where courage in a politician is understood by everybody as standing up to the weapons dealers and warmongers and saying No I won’t do war.


When I first wrote

War Is A Lie

 I thought we were making progress at spotting war lies and wanted that progress to accelerate. In U.S. polling it took about a year and a half from the start of the war on Afghanistan and the start of the war on Iraq to get a majority saying that each war never should have been started. It took much longer than that to get a majority saying each war should be ended. This was because thousands of members of the U.S. military had been killed, and some twisted logic told us that the only way to respect those already killed was to get more killed. It didn’t matter if polling of members of the military found that they wanted to come home, or if their suicides were outpacing their deaths in combat, or if 30 or 40 times as many Iraqis were being killed as U.S. troops — in fact that last bit of information went beyond not mattering to the point of it almost being treasonous to become aware of it. My dream was that we could get faster at opposing the wars, that we could get huge majorities to realize how they were being tricked into supporting horrific evil before a war even started.


And I thought we were making progress. While wars that do not happen never make it into history books, public opposition repeatedly prevented a war on Iran, until it didn’t. And it prevented a massive bombing campaign on Syria. We still weren’t going after the money, the military budget that would generate more wars. We still weren’t dismantling the empire of bases, joining treaties or courts, pursuing cooperation and aid and peacemaking. We still hadn’t moved from each of these many wars is wrong to all possible wars are wrong. But we were taking baby steps.


And then WHAM — Ukraine ate our brains.


I want to go back for a second to 100 years ago when war wasn’t what it would become and wasn’t widely understood even for what it was, to a time when the United States had been training Japan in imperialism and encouraging it to invade and occupy Korea. Well, Japan’s empire and the United States’ own empire collided. The U.S. took over numerous islands, staged its war rehearsals nearby, and threatened and sanctioned Japan. The public issue of the …

author: anred
title: Fuegos sincronizados: cientos de hornos se encendieron para construir una obra colectiva
content:
Después de una videollamada que conectó a ceramistas de distintos puntos del país y del mundo, durante la noche del 26 de septiembre cientos de hornos se encendieron al mismo tiempo. Por Manuela Wilhelm (ANRed)


Mientras en cada taller la arcilla atravesaba el calor y esperaba la transformación del fuego, quienes participaban compartían imágenes, videos y mensajes desde sus propios territorios. La propuesta había nacido casi como un juego, pero terminó convirtiéndose en una enorme experiencia colectiva.


Carlos Ovando, conocido como “Lalo”

, ceramista mendocino en Tawa Taller y constructor de hornos, todavía intenta dimensionar qué fue lo que puso en movimiento. La transmisión en vivo que habían preparado terminó borrada —“no sé qué hice y lo borré todo”, cuenta entre risas—, pero eso poco importó. La experiencia quedó registrada en cada taller, en cada grupo de WhatsApp, en cada video compartido y en una cartografía que permite imaginar la dimensión que alcanzó aquella noche.


El censo elaborado por la organización reúne

416 registros de personas, talleres o colectivos de 18 países

. Argentina concentró la mayor parte, con 318 registros, seguida por Chile y México, con 18 cada uno; Brasil, con 17; Colombia, con 12; y Perú, con 6. También hubo participación de España, Uruguay, Costa Rica, Ecuador, Paraguay, Portugal, Francia, Suecia, Japón, Taiwán, Nueva Zelanda y Estados Unidos.


No era necesario tener un horno a leña. La convocatoria estaba abierta a hornos a leña, a gas y eléctricos. La única condición era sumarse a ese gesto común: encender, hornear y acompañarse a la distancia.


Una idea que nació casi jugando


La primera chispa apareció a partir de una horneada que se iba a realizar en La Plata, en el taller de la ceramista Aluminé Fernández. Lalo, que vive en San Carlos, Mendoza, había construido allí un horno meses antes. Le escribió a su compañera para avisarle que iba a participar y, casi jugando, se le ocurrió que podía acompañarla desde Mendoza.


“Se me ocurrió que podía acompañarla de manera sincrónica. O sea, hornear simultáneamente”, cuenta.


El equipo de

Fuegos Sincronizados

 quedó conformado por

Lalo, Flavia Torres, Aluminé Fernández, Fernanda Guevara, Julia Spangenberg y Silvana Ruiz Charó.


La idea tampoco era completamente nueva para él. Años atrás había realizado junto a otros ceramistas mendocinos varias horneadas sincronizadas vinculadas a una muestra de esculturas en cerámica y a la noche y la luna. Eran apenas tres personas conectadas por WhatsApp o videollamada. Esta vez, sin embargo, la propuesta podía crecer.


Primero convocó a ceramistas cuyos hornos había ayudado a construir en Córdoba y Chile. Después se sumaron otras personas conocidas. La convocatoria comenzó a circular por WhatsApp hasta que una compañera de Córdoba, Julia, le propuso hacer un video y abrirla mucho más.


“

Ahí explotó todo”, recuerda.


La comunidad ceramista respondió rápidamente. El grupo de WhatsApp llegó a superar las 600 personas y fue necesario armar un pequeño equipo de organización. De allí surgió también la idea de

construir una cartografía

 con los lugares donde se encenderían los hornos.


La iniciativa fue creciendo al mismo tiempo que se organizaba. Se creó una cuenta de Instagram, se elaboraron placas informativas y se buscó la manera de conectar a los distintos grupos. Incluso intentaron transmitir en vivo desde la nueva cuenta, pero no pudieron hacerlo por las restricciones de antigüedad de Instagram. Finalmente utilizaron la cuenta personal de Lalo y también realizaron una transmisión por Meet y YouTube.


Y aunque ese registro terminó borrado, quedaron las huellas dispersas de la experiencia: los videos de cada taller, las fotografías, los mensajes y, sobre todo, el mapa.


Un fuego que no arrasa: une


Para Lalo, allí está una de las claves de la propuesta. El fuego ocupa un lugar central en la práctica ceramista. Es el momento en que una pieza cambia definitivamente, pero también un momento íntimo, de espera y de encuentro.


“El objetivo de la sincronización era poder conectarnos y juntarnos a través del fuego”, explica.


Por eso hace una distinción: no se trata de cualquier fuego. “

No es un fuego arrasador de esos que no queremos, sino que es un fuego que une

”, dice.


Cada horno tenía sus propias características. Había hornos grandes y pequeños, hornos a leña, a gas, eléctricos y hasta hornos en pozo. Había talleres con condiciones muy diferentes, ubicados en …

author: Ethel Rudnitzki
title: Quase mil anúncios sobre Lula e Flávio na Meta foram pagos em dólar
content:
Ao menos 1.069 anúncios com menções a Lula (PT) ou Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) no Facebook, Instagram e Threads foram pagos em dólar durante a campanha eleitoral de 2026. Dados da Biblioteca de Anúncios da Meta analisados pela

Agência Pública

 revelam que os conteúdos custaram ao menos US$ 120,8 mil.


Os anúncios circularam sem rótulo de conteúdo político, mecanismo exigido pelas regras da Meta, entre 16 de agosto e 30 de setembro. Por isso, foram removidos por violação das regras da plataforma. Mas antes disso chegaram a mais de 82 milhões de impressões (número de vezes que um anúncio apareceu em uma tela).


O rótulo exige uma maior transparência sobre os anunciantes. Se os anúncios não estiverem rotulados como políticos, as páginas não são obrigadas a informar quem pagou pelos anúncios nem o público ao qual os conteúdos foram direcionados.


Impulsionamento do exterior


Algumas, no entanto, divulgaram à Meta que os anúncios foram pagos usando uma plataforma de pagamentos norte-americana chamada pagolink.global, não disponível no Brasil. A empresa tem sede em Delaware, estado que não exige identificação de sócios. Através dela, foi impulsionada uma campanha de conteúdos a favor do candidato Augusto Cury (Avante), conforme

revelou a Agência Lupa

.


Dentre os anúncios analisados pela

Pública

, a PagoLink Global foi responsável, por exemplo, pelo pagamento de um anúncio com um vídeo desinformativo sobre Lula (PT). Nele, o deputado Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG)

tira de contexto uma fala do presidente

 para insinuar que ele teria ofendido garis. O post rodou nas redes sociais da Meta antes de ser suspenso, e atingiu mais de 150 mil impressões.


Anúncio com vídeo descontextualizado de Lula foi pago por empresa americana


Foi também através da PagoLink Global que foram impulsionados conteúdos contrários a Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). Entre eles, um anúncio que

direcionava à reportagem do ICL

 que revelou que a empresa do candidato dividia endereço com escritório de Camilo Antunes, investigado por fraudes no INSS. O conteúdo atingiu mais de 70 mil impressões a um custo de US$ 200.


Anúncio pago por empresa dos EUA direcionava para reportagem sobre empresa de Flávio Bolsonaro (PL)


Para a advogada eleitoral Vânia Aieta, o mero uso de plataformas estrangeiras para o pagamento de anúncios não configura, por si só, uma violação, desde que seja declarado à Justiça Eleitoral.


Os anúncios, no entanto, violam norma eleitoral que proíbe o impulsionamento por terceiros.


“Não é permitido pagamento de impulsionamento se não for feito ⁠pela pessoa candidata ou por seu partido/federação ou diretamente da conta corrente eleitoral. Como a conta corrente eleitoral é obrigatoriamente em reais, também não pode haver pagamento em dólar”, explica o advogado Fernando Neisser.


Também é proibida a veiculação de anúncios com propagandas negativas sobre outros candidatos. “O impulsionamento de conteúdo em provedor de aplicação de internet somente poderá ser utilizado para promover ou beneficiar candidatura, partido político ou federação que o contrate”, diz a

resolução nº 23.732/2024

 do TSE.


“Impulsionamento ilegal tem previsão de multa de 5 mil reais ou o dobro do valor gasto naquele impulsionamento, o que for maior”, informa Neisser.


A

Pública

 questionou a Meta sobre a veiculação dos anúncios em desacordo com as regras eleitorais, mas não obteve resposta até a publicação da reportagem.

author: Unknown
title: 6 OCTOBRE : ACTE III
content:
Mardi 6 octobre, on y va déter, équipés et solidaires : grève nationale et blocage total !


Wesh l'équipe, faut qu'on parle de ce qui se passe en ce moment, parce que c'est hyper grave.


Le gouvernement Lecornu vient de présenter son projet de budget pour 2027, et c'est une énorme cure d'austérité : 54 milliards d'euros d'économies sur notre dos.


Concrètement, ils veulent supprimer 1 588 postes de profs (alors qu'on est déjà souvent plus de 35 par classe !), et geler les APL ainsi que les allocations familiales. Bref, c'est une attaque directe contre la jeunesse et les familles les plus pauvres.


Depuis fin septembre, on s'est mobilisés en masse dans les lycées. Mais la réponse de l'État est ultra-violente. En quelques jours, il y a déjà eu plus de 5 000 interpellations (rien que le jeudi 1er octobre, ils ont arrêté 1 949 personnes !).


Le pire, c'est qu'il y a déjà au moins 170 élèves blessés. À Tours et à Argenteuil, des lycéens de 16 ans ont été gravement touchés à l'œil par des tirs policiers, et à Saint-Denis, un autre a fini à l'hôpital pour une suspicion de fracture du crâne.


Face à cette violence, on ne peut plus juste attendre gentiment. Les syndicats officiels (comme la FIDL ou l'Union étudiante) et les partis politiques comme LFI nous demandent de faire des marches pacifiques ou d'attendre sagement les élections de 2027.


Mais on sait très bien que les marches déclarées ne suffisent plus. Ce qui marche vraiment, c'est le blocage strict et le rapport de force.


La preuve : la ministre a déjà dû reculer sur la tarification des BTS et des Prépas grâce à la pression de la rue !


Pour tenir le coup, la rue n'est pas un choix politique, c'est une nécessité.


On doit s'organiser, se protéger et faire bloc.


 🛡️

GUIDE DE SURVIE : DE LA RUE À LA GAV


Pour que la solidarité soit notre meilleure arme face à la répression, voici les règles d'or et techniques de défense collective (defco).


 En manif : "Be Water" et protection collective


Matos de base

 : Du sérum phy pour les yeux, des fringues sombres et neutres (pas de marques visibles), un masque de protection FFP2, des lunettes de protections, et surtout le numéro d'un groupe d'anti-répression ou d'un proche écrit au marqueur sur le bras.


Technique du parapluie

 : Les parapluies ne servent pas qu'à se cacher. Ouvrir plusieurs parapluies à l'avant et sur les côtés du cortège crée un mur visuel instantané. Ça bloque les caméras de surveillance, empêche les flics de cibler des personnes et protège des tirs de gaz lacrymo ou de LBD.


"Be Water" (Sois l'eau)

 : Pas de position fixe si on est encerclés ou dépassés. On reste mobiles, fluides et spontanés. Si une charge arrive, on reflue ensemble sans paniquer, et on se reforme plus loin. On évite de rester statique face aux nasses.


 En cas d'interpellation : La base légale de la Defco


Si tu te fais choper par les flics, active immédiatement le mode "Défense Collective". En garde à vue (GAV), tu as des droits fondamentaux que la police essaiera de te faire oublier.


Applique la règle des 3 piliers :


Le Droit au Silence

 : C'est ta meilleure arme. À TOUTES les questions (sauf ton identité de base : nom, prénom, adresse), ta seule et unique réponse doit être : « Je n'ai rien à déclarer ». Ne cherche pas à te justifier ou à raconter ton histoire "pour sortir plus vite", ça sera retenu contre toi ou tes potes.


L'Avocat·e choisi·e

 ou commis·e d'office : Exige un·e avocat·e dès le début. Aucune audition ou interrogatoire ne peut commencer sans sa présence. Si tu as le nom d'un avocat anti-rep ou d'un collectif sur ton bras, donne-le. Sinon, demande l'avocat d'office.


Le Médecin

 : Demande à voir un médecin, même si tu penses n'avoir rien. C'est capital pour faire constater d'éventuels coups ou violences policières subis pendant l'interpellation, et ça laisse une trace officielle. Pareil si tu as des médicaments à prendre (pense à en avoir avec toi). Ne dis rien au médecin qui puisse être utilisé contre toi.


Ne rien signer à l'aveugle

 : Ne signe aucun document (procès-verbal, déclaration) sans l'avoir lu attentivement. Si tu n'es pas d'accord avec ce qui est écrit ou si on a déformé tes propos, refuse de signer.


Rappel crucial pour les mineurs (90% des interpellés en ce moment)

 : Les flics ont l'obligation de prévenir tes parents ou tuteurs légaux immédiatement. La présence d'un avocat est obligatoire pour les mineurs pendant les auditions. Ne te laisse pas impressionner par leurs …

author: Sérgio Spagnuolo
title: Processos sobre desinformação e propaganda digital triplicam nas eleições de 2026
content:
O volume de reclamações judiciais sobre desinformação e publicidade digital irregular quase triplicou na Justiça Eleitoral em 2026 em relação às eleições de 2022, totalizando 9.571 processos no mesmo período até 1º.out.2026.


Esse montante corresponde a 11,4% do total de processos desse ciclo eleitoral, frente a 4,1% das eleições de 2022, de acordo com análise de dados feita pelo Núcleo.


A maioria desse tipo de processos envolve propaganda irregular em redes sociais e na internet em geral, inclusive impulsionamento de conteúdo denunciado.


Ao todo, o TSE já registrou ao menos 84,1 mil processos judiciais nesse ciclo eleitoral até 1º.out, cerca de 1% a mais do que no mesmo período em 2022.


Como fizemos isso


O

Núcleo

 acessou dados de processos eleitorais no

repositório de dados abertos

 do TSE. Última data de acesso 1º.out.2026.


Esses dados possuem um campo de assunto principal do processo em questão, além de outros assuntos relacionados. O

Núcleo

 fez a junção de duas tabelas a fim de saber todos os assuntos mencionados, a partir do seguinte filtro.


internet

 (Propaganda Política – Propaganda Eleitoral – Internet)


redes sociais

 (Propaganda Política – Propaganda Eleitoral – Redes Sociais)


impulsionamento

 (Propaganda Política – Propaganda Eleitoral – Impulsionamento)


app de mensagem

 (Propaganda Política – Propaganda Eleitoral – Aplicativo de Mensagem Instantânea)


inteligência artificial

 (Propaganda Política – Propaganda Eleitoral – Uso de Inteligência Artificial)


deep_fake

 (Propaganda Política – Propaganda Eleitoral – Deep Fake) 


fake news


Propaganda Política – Propaganda Eleitoral – Divulgação de Notícia Sabidamente Falsa (fake_news_a)


Propaganda Política – Propaganda Eleitoral – Divulgação de Notícia Sabidamente Falsa (fake_news_b, variante com caractere diferente)


Divulgação de Falsa Imputação (fake_news_c)


Desinformação sobre a Integridade do Processo Eleitoral (fake_news_d)


Divulgação de Fatos Inverídicos na Propaganda Eleitoral (fake_news_e)


Para a análise foram considerados processos únicos, levando em conta que um processo pode aparecer mais de uma vez quando muda de relator ou de instância. Vale notar que, embora a campanha oficial tenha começado em 16.ago.2026, há processos anteriores a isso sobre essas eleições na Justiça.


O

Núcleo

 utilizou o modelo de IA Claude Fable 5.1 para checar as análises desenvolvidas por humanos e sugerir melhorias.

author: Unknown
title: Turkish companies accelerate tree cutting in the Behdînan region
content:
In recent days, Turkish companies have intensified tree cutting in the Behdînan region, encompassing Zaxo, Duhok, Berwarî Bala and Amediyê. Increasing their logging activities ahead of winter, the Turkish companies are transporting the trees across the border in trucks under military supervision. Footage shows dozens of trucks carrying felled trees from rural areas. Some of the trucks are accompanied by Turkish armored vehicles.


Over the past 10 days, felled trees have been transported by more than 250 trucks in the Berwarî Bala area of Amediyê district in Duhok.


Residents who filmed the footage protested the tree cutting, saying: “What you see here are felled trees. These trucks belong to the Turks. They are transporting trees cut down in Kurdistan. At the security checkpoint, our vehicles were stopped to facilitate the passage of the trucks loaded with trees.”


According to information provided to Rojnews by local sources, some of the areas and villages where tree cutting has intensified include Mîska, Qumri, Hirûrê, Kêste, Tirwaniş and Nizdûrê in Berwarî Bala. The sources said that the destruction of trees in the region has accelerated particularly with the approach of winter.


The tree cutting is reportedly concentrated near the Turkish military base at Girê Biyê. Trees felled under the supervision of soldiers are being transported to Turkey through the Serzêr border crossing.


Turkish soldiers are reportedly present in the areas where tree cutting continues, and civilian access to these areas is prohibited. Hundreds of villages had been evacuated following the start of Turkey’s military operations in the region.


While the Kurdistan Regional Government and the Iraqi government remain silent over the tree cutting, residents of Behdînan have reacted to both this silence and the destruction of nature by sharing footage on social media.

author: Taya Graham
title: Maryland Used Discredited Science to Convict a Woman of Murdering Her Newborn
content:
Advocates say the case is an alarming example of the prevalence of unsubstantiated forensic science.

Support justice-driven, accurate and transparent news — make a quick donation to Truthout today!

Moira Akers was prosecuted and convicted of the murder of a newborn in 2022. She claims to have given birth to a stillborn baby in her home in Columbia, Maryland, in 2018.

Prosecutors doubted Akers’ story, using her online searches for abortion services and lack of prenatal care as evidence of ill intent. But it was a “forensic method” devised in the 17th century that proved key to Akers’ conviction.

The method, known as a “float test,” was designed to determine if a baby was stillborn or born alive by placing the lungs of a deceased fetus in water. If the lungs float, then they are aerated, meaning the baby was breathing and alive prior to their death.

In 2018, former Maryland chief medical examiner Dr. David Fowler signed the autopsy report that, using the float test as proof, determined that Akers’ baby died after Akers asphyxiated it. Fowler also testified in Akers’ trial. Prosecutors used Fowler’s testimony and autopsy report as evidence to convict Akers of second-degree murder in 2022.

Similar to Fowler’s infamous 2021 testimony in the trial of former Minneapolis police officer Derek Chauvin, in which he argued that George Floyd died due to drug intoxication and inhaling fumes from a car tailpipe, Fowler’s citation of the float test in Akers’ case has elicited criticism from the medical community.

Fowler was also the subject of a scathing audit released by the Maryland Attorney General’s office last year, which found that at least 36 cases involving deaths that occurred during police restraint were improperly ruled accidents or left unclassified during his tenure

The float test has been widely discredited as imprecise and lacking methodological rigor.

In the course of our reporting on Akers’ case, we not only reviewed court transcripts and the testimony of physicians and medical experts; we also pressed Fowler’s former office for comment about whether or not the float test was still used in fetal death investigations. Just prior to publication, Maryland Department of Health spokesman David McCallister disavowed the test.

“The lung float test is not part of OCME’s current routine practice, which reflects evolving scientific evidence, National Association of Medical Examiner (NAME) guidance, and the independent medical judgment of our forensic pathologists,” McCallister wrote in an email.

“When performed historically, the test was only one component of the overall forensic assessment and was interpreted together with the investigative and autopsy findings. How an individual autopsy finding is characterized or used in criminal prosecution is separate from OCME’s medical determination of cause and manner of death.”

McCallister’s disavowal of the float test marks a stunning departure from past practices for determining causes of death in Maryland. Whether the change will affect Akers’ case remains to be seen.

But what hasn’t changed is the fact that Akers was convicted, has served three years in prison, and is facing another prosecution—all while advocates and her lawyers are still fighting against a bureaucracy wedded to Fowler’s past practices.

Akers’ fate remains in legal limbo, but her story reveals how flawed science can have real-life consequences, and how an indifferent bureaucracy can defend the mistakes of the past despite public outcry and scientific pushback in the present.

Akers’ ordeal began in November of 2018.

According to a statement she gave to police, Akers was watching TV with her daughter when she noticed she was bleeding. The Howard County resident retreated to her upstairs bedroom. There, she gave birth to what she described as a baby that was not breathing, or stillborn.

The mother of two young children told police her husband did not want another child. Finances were tight, and the couple was already struggling to care for both a toddler and an 8-year-old.

“I almost didn’t want to admit to myself that it was [a pregnancy],” she told police.

She hid the possible pregnancy from her family and did not seek prenatal care. “I just didn’t want my family [to know],” Akers said, “a stigma of them knowing that we had even contemplated the abortion part, but knowing that they wouldn’t be happy if we gave up the baby officially for adoption… that’s why I looked into the safe haven stuff.” …

author: Reddebrek
title: 1983 Red Monarch
content:
Red Monarch is a 1983 British television film, starring Colin Blakely as Joseph Stalin. It is directed by Jack Gold and features David Suchet as Lavrentiy Beria and David Threlfall as Stalin's son Vasily.


Red Monarch is a black comedy based on The Red Monarch: Scenes from the Life of Stalin, a collection of short critical essays by the Russian dissident and former KGB agent Yuri Krotkov. The film depicts Soviet politics and the interplay between Stalin and his lieutenants, particularly Beria, during the last years of Stalin's rule. The reading of Yevgeny Yevtushenko's "The Heirs of Stalin" in the final scene supposedly warns that the threat of totalitarianism is constantly present.


Throughout the film, Stalin and Beria's accents are Irish, intended to single them out as Georgian. This is the natural accent of Colin Blakely and is put on by David Suchet. Most of the others actors have northern English accents, seen as stereotypically working class.

author: Unknown
title: KNK Conference in Brussels: Kurdish international representation must be strengthened
content:
The conference organized by the Kurdistan National Congress (KNK) in Brussels to discuss Kurdish representation at the United Nations (UN) and the demand for international status continues with presentations by experts in international law and human rights.


Barry A. Fisher, an international law expert, delivered the first presentation at a panel discussion that also featured Prof. Miloon Kothari and former Iraqi Human Rights Minister Bakhtiyar Amin. Fisher, who has been involved in constitution and legislation drafting as well as legal reform efforts in various countries, offered assessments on the international status of the Kurds, their representation at the UN, and regional developments.


Fisher: It is now time to rectify the injustice experienced by the Kurds


In his presentation titled “For the Rebirth of the Kurdish Nation,” Barry A. Fisher said that recognition of the Kurds at the UN and obtaining observer status were among the central objectives of the international campaign. Fisher addressed a wide range of issues, from Turkey’s military presence in Syria and Iraq and regional alliances to Kurdish international representation and diaspora efforts.


Fisher said that the Kurds have lived in the northern part of ancient Mesopotamia for more than 2,000 years, noting that the political order changed following the First World War and the collapse of the Ottoman Empire. Referring to the processes surrounding the Treaties of Sèvres and Lausanne, Fisher said that the Kurds were left within the borders of four states and have faced the consequences of this division for 103 years. “It is now time to rectify this injustice and restore to more than 60 million Kurds—the world’s largest stateless nation—the united national homeland that was promised to them during the collapse of the Ottoman Empire.”


Comparison of the current period with the aftermath of the First World War


Fisher said that competition among major powers is creating new spheres of influence, comparing the current period with the aftermath of the First World War. According to Fisher, US President Donald Trump, Russian President Vladimir Putin and Chinese President Xi Jinping are seeking to expand their spheres of influence in different regions, while Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan is also seeking greater room for maneuver in Syria and elsewhere within these shifting power dynamics.


Turkey’s Kurdish policy and military presence


Fisher also addressed Turkey’s policy toward the Kurds, offering assessments on the arrest of Kurdish politicians, pressure on political parties, and policies toward different communities. He said that Turkey has more than 100 military bases, outposts and checkpoints in the Kurdistan Region, and drew attention to Ankara’s military presence in Northern Cyprus, Libya, Lebanon, Somalia and Iraq.


Remarking that Turkey has maintained a military presence in northern Syria since 2016, he highlighted its implications for Rojava and the political role of the Kurds in Syria.


Referring to the Euphrates Shield and Afrin operations, Fisher said that the demographic composition of the region had been altered, Kurds had been displaced, and properties had been seized. He added that Turkey’s influence in Syria had increased following the fall of Assad in December 2024, drawing attention to Ankara’s developing military and political relations with the new administration in Damascus.


Fisher also addressed the “Countries Neighboring Syria” mechanism, the Turkey-Syria defense agreement, the “Regional Quartet” or “R4,” which emerged on the agenda in 2026, and the “Mecca Alliance” between Turkey, Pakistan and Saudi Arabia. He said these structures should be assessed in the context of Turkey’s expanding military and political influence in the Middle East. He also discussed Turkey’s presence in Somalia and the Red Sea within this framework.


Recognition of the Kurds at the UN is key to the international campaign


Outlining his recommendations regarding the KNK’s international efforts, Fisher described recognition of the Kurds at the UN and obtaining observer status as “the key to the campaign.” He said the KNK should expand its opportunities for representation and consultative status at the Council of Europe, the UN, in the United States and within other regional organizations. He also called for the Kurdish diaspora to be included in these efforts and recommended strengthening relations with organizations such as the …

author: Unknown
title: Zübeyir Aydar at KNK Conference: Kurds must have a presence on international platforms
content:
The conference organized by the Kurdistan National Congress (KNK) in Brussels to discuss Kurdish representation at the United Nations (UN) and the demand for international status is continuing. Discussions at the conference focus on Kurdish representation in the international arena, diplomatic initiatives and efforts to secure status at the UN. Representatives of political parties and other figures attending the conference took the floor to express their views.


‘We will do everything we can to support Kurdish representation at the UN’


Former Icelandic Foreign Minister Ögmundur Jónasson said in his speech:


“I bring greetings from Iceland, from the Kurds in Iceland, and from the friends of the Kurds in Iceland. I am one of them. I came here to support this very important initiative that you have launched. We will do everything we can to support the Kurds in obtaining observer status at the United Nations.


I would like to thank you for a very informative morning. The speeches delivered by representatives of the Kurdistan Regional Government and by experts were highly informative for me, particularly regarding the historical context of the Kurds, the geopolitical situation, and the functioning of the United Nations. I thank you for that.


I am not going to say anything particularly important now, but I would like to begin by telling you about something that happened to me earlier this week. I was asked to take part in a Gallup opinion poll. First, they asked me about my health and whether I was satisfied and happy. I scored quite highly on the happiness scale.


Then they asked me what I thought about certain states. They wanted to know how I felt about the United States, China, Russia and the European Union. When the questions turned to the future, however, this positive person—that is, me—became critical and even pessimistic. The reason, of course, was the way the questions were framed.


If I had been asked what I thought about Americans, Chinese people, Russians and people living in the European Union in general, I would have been on the positive side. The problem is states, not people. Of course, some individuals can be a problem, but peoples in general are not.


People’s well-being is largely determined by states, and this is where states differ from one another. The Kurds have been denied the right to a state. More than 60 million Kurds are also being denied the right to voice their grievances at the United Nations, the international forum of state power.


Moreover, the United Nations itself is under attack. The rules-based international order is being systematically weakened and is increasingly coming under the influence of the military-industrial complex that US President Dwight D. Eisenhower warned about when leaving office in 1961.


This is where I come to the Kurds and why I believe it is necessary for them to have a voice at the United Nations.”


PUK: An important step toward the unity of the Kurdish people


Speaking on behalf of the Patriotic Union of Kurdistan (PUK), Şêx Şemal stated that the Kurds need strong and unified representation in the international arena. Highlighting the importance of a Kurdish National Congress encompassing all four parts of Kurdistan, Şemal said that such a congress would be significant in bringing the social and national will of the Kurds together on a common platform.


Şemal stated that the Kurds’ right to self-determination is a legitimate one and that the struggle for this right must continue. Emphasizing the importance of Kurds being represented internationally under their own identity and name, Şemal said that Kurds living within the borders of different countries are a people who have maintained their existence while preserving their language, culture and identity.


Pointing out that more than 60 million Kurds live across the geography inhabited by the Kurdish people, Şemal said that this shared social presence should be represented more strongly in the international arena. He emphasized that Kurds should not only be represented in international institutions but should also actively participate in their work, stressing the importance of making more effective use of existing international mechanisms to safeguard Kurdish rights.


Şemal stated that mechanisms capable of bringing the common will and demands of the Kurds to the international arena should be developed, adding that the Kurdish National Congress could play an important role in this regard …

author: Unknown
title: Final declaration at KNK conference: Committee to be established for Kurdish representation at UN
content:
The final declaration of the Conference on the Representation of the Kurdish Nation at the United Nations, hosted by the Kurdistan National Congress (KNK) in Brussels, has been released.


The declaration calls for the Kurds to be recognized as a nation at the UN and represented as observers in UN-affiliated institutions. It also states that a long-term effort should be undertaken to secure representation for the Kurds at the United Nations.


 


The final declaration reads as follows:


“Upon the invitation of the KNK, we, representatives of parties, organizations, and Kurdish institutions from the four parts of Kurdistan and abroad, together with independent individuals from various professions and some friends of the Kurdish people, gathered in Brussels, Belgium, on October 3, 2026, and held a conference under the name Conference on the Representation of the Kurdish Nation at the United Nations. Following extensive discussions, we present this final declaration to the public.


Kurdistan is located in Western Asia, between Turkey, Iran, Iraq, and Syria, and the geography of Kurdistan covers an area of approximately five hundred thousand (500,000) square kilometers. The Kurdish people are one of the ancient peoples of this geography. They have lived in this geography for thousands of years, given their name to this geography, and the name of this geography has been Kurdistan for more than a thousand years.


The population of the people of Kurdistan is approximately sixty million (60,000,000). Despite this large population, the Kurds are not recognized or represented as a nation in international institutions. Particularly at the United Nations, where almost all nations have the right to representation in this organization, the name of the Kurdish nation is absent from the institution, the Kurds are not recognized as a nation, and there is no representative at the UN acting on behalf of the Kurdish nation.


This situation constitutes a major deficiency in the lives of the Kurdish nation and all the peoples of Kurdistan and lies at the root of many questions and problems. For this reason, the KNK placed this issue on the agenda of its 24th General Assembly (June 6–7, 2026). Following extensive discussions, a decision was made to apply to the United Nations so that the Kurds, like other nations, would be recognized and represented as observers in UN-affiliated institutions, in a status similar to that of the Palestinians. Within this framework, meetings were held with experts and their views were sought. Based on these views, a letter was submitted on behalf of the KNK to UN Secretary-General Mr. António Guterres.


However, this is a major and difficult issue; it cannot be resolved through a few narrowly focused meetings and the submission of a few letters. The KNK cannot undertake this effort alone. National and international cooperation is needed. Regardless of the perspective from which it is considered, there is a great need for leaders, administrators, representatives, and all components and sections of Kurdish society with a role in society to come together at the highest level, establish committees, discuss this issue, and make decisions. The people of Kurdistan must be mobilized through meetings, actions, and strong campaigns. Through this conference, we are bringing this important issue to the agenda of Kurdistan and the world. We are beginning a long-term effort. In this work, we will use all diplomatic methods and conduct comprehensive campaigns.


Within this framework, as participants in the Conference on the Representation of the Kurdish Nation at the United Nations, we announce the following to the public:


- The conference considers and supports the KNK’s work, decision, and application in this field as important.


- The conference considers securing representation for the Kurdish nation at the United Nations to be one of the fundamental tasks of Kurdish diplomacy and places this effort before all relevant parties, organizations, institutions, and individuals.


- The conference regards the efforts to secure representation for the Kurdish nation at the United Nations as a long-term undertaking and states that this is not the work of a single organization, but a national and patriotic effort.


- The conference is establishing a working committee called the “Committee for Achieving Representation of the Kurdish Nation at the United Nations” for the purpose of carrying out this work, and calls on …

author: Novara Media
title: Secrets of the Chinese Internet
content:
Welcome to Series 2 of Do Your Own Research. Until the end of the year, I will be focusing on the most important and interesting country in the world: China.


We’re starting with Tianyu Fang, an editor of Chaoyang Trap, a newsletter all about the Chinese internet.


We’re starting with the internet because that’s so much of what we see of China: fragments of life online. What’s the reality behind them, and how do we square these beguiling, details with the vast story of China’s rise?


What is happening online in China is often reduced to a few memes or movements. We see the dazzling skyline and we stop thinking, and start gawping: that’s what I call the gawp-zone. How do we get out of it?


In this conversation, we go far deeper, into the circuits and technology of the Chinese internet, from its earliest utopian moments to the hemisphere-spanning computing stack we see today.


And we’ll be making our map of everything that has ever mattered and ever will: this new edition focused on China, available here: novaramedia.com/dyor

author: anred
title: Diputados mendocinos aprobaron el nuevo Régimen Penal Juvenil: más mano dura contra los pibes para no cambiar nada
content:
El miércoles 30 de septiembre la Cámara de Diputados de Mendoza sancionó el nuevo Régimen Penal Juvenil. La nueva ley baja la edad de imputabilidad de 16 a 14 años. La aprobación fue por amplia mayoría: 32 votos a favor, 10 en contra y 0 abstenciones. El nuevo Régimen Penal Juvenil de Mendoza pone en la mira a las principales víctimas del ajuste de Javier Milei y Alfredo Cornejo. En lugar de invertir en educación y asistencia para tratar los problemas de salud mental y consumos problemáticos, el gobierno va a destinar más dinero en cárceles y represión. Por Francisco Ayala*.


 


Bajar la edad de imputabilidad no reduce el delito


Cornejo y la ministra de Seguridad Mercedes Rus se suman al coro de mentiras de Milei y Patricia Bullrich. Quieren presentar a las infancias y adolescencias como responsables de una inseguridad que crece al calor del brutal ajuste del gobierno nacional, provincial y el FMI.


Sin embargo, las estadísticas internacionales son contundentes. UNICEF, la Comisión Interamericana de Derechos Humanos y la propia Convención sobre los Derechos del Niño de la ONU muestran que reducir la edad de imputabilidad no baja el delito, sino que lo aumenta.


En Ecuador, donde la edad de punibilidad es de 12 años, el índice de delitos pasó de 6 a 46 cada 100 mil habitantes. En Brasil y Uruguay, donde la punibilidad comienza a los 12 y 13 años respectivamente, los niveles de violencia no disminuyeron. Dinamarca y Georgia incluso dieron marcha atrás luego de comprobar los efectos regresivos de estas políticas.


¿Qué muestran los datos en Mendoza?


En nuestra provincia, según el último censo, alrededor del 8% de la población tiene entre 13 y 17 años, de los cuales el 45,2% son pobres y el 10,9% se encuentra en la indigencia, según datos del INDEC. En el último tiempo, la principal causa de muertes en jóvenes es por suicidio, superando incluso a los accidentes viales.


La campaña punitivista de Cornejo y Rus se monta sobre la falsedad de que la delincuencia en adolescentes es mayoritaria. Pero según UNICEF, solo el 0,45% de las chicas y chicos de entre 12 y 17 años cometió algún delito. El gobierno oculta esta realidad para poner el foco donde no está el problema.


Políticas integrales, no cárceles


Por más que el gobierno provincial prometa políticas de reinserción, lo cierto es que el encarcelamiento temprano no «recuperó» a nadie. El gobernador en más de una oportunidad se jactó de haber subido la cantidad de personas privadas de su libertad en la provincia. Si la delincuencia crece es precisamente por las políticas de ajuste, exclusión social y connivencia con el narcotráfico y las mafias. ¿De qué se jacta Cornejo? Más cárceles y represión es precisamente el reflejo de un gobierno pésimo para el pueblo trabajador.


Sabemos que la inseguridad es un flagelo que nos golpea principalmente a las y los trabajadores y sectores populares que vivimos en los barrios. Pero decir que se va a solucionar el problema con violencia contra pibas y pibes pobres es tomarnos por tontos.


Para terminar con la inseguridad, desde Izquierda Socialista y el Frente de Izquierda Unidad sabemos lo que hay que hacer. Lo primero es que los salarios sean, como mínimo, iguales a la canasta familiar. Nada alienta más a la delincuencia que saber que trabajando honestamente se vive cada vez peor.


Hay que terminar con la connivencia de las mafias y redes de narcotráfico con la policía y los gobiernos. Es imposible que operen a la vista de todo el mundo y solo caiga cada tanto algún «perejil» y nunca un «peso pesado».


Por último, y lo más importante, hay que subir los presupuestos para educación y asistencia a los problemas de salud mental y consumos problemáticos. Con asistencia a las infancias y adolescencias se ahorra el sufrimiento de las familias y dinero del Estado. Se gasta mucho más en cárceles y represión que en educación y salud. ¿O será que hay gente a la que le es muy redituable no solucionar el problema de verdad y echarle la culpa a las y los pibes pobres?.


 


*Ayala es parte de Izquiuera Socialista.

title: Direct Action (SolFed) #04 1997
content:
كيف ندير الحزب اليوم يعكس كيف سندير المجتمع غدا


أنطلق في هذا النص من قناعة بأن الحزب اليساري صورة مصغرة للمجتمع الذي يسعى إلى بنائه وإدارته، وأن نظامه الداخلي يعكس بصورة مبكرة شكل الإدارة التي سيقدمها إذا تولى القيادة في الدولة. فالطريقة التي تتخذ بها القرارات داخل الحزب، وموقع القاعدة فيها، وحدود صلاحيات القيادة، ومدى احترام الرأي المختلف وغيرها، كلها تقدم للجماهير إجابة عملية عن سؤال جوهري: هل تكون السلطة في المجتمع الذي ننشده بيد الجماهير نفسها وتحت رقابتها المستمرة، أم تتركز في يد هيئات محدودة مهما حسنت نواياها؟ ومن هنا تأتي أهمية أن يجسد النظام الداخلي منذ اليوم قيم الديمقراطية والمشاركة والشفافية والتداول التي نعد بها المجتمع غدا.


Author


رزكار عقراوي


Rezgar Akrawi


    Submitted by

rezgar2

 on October 3, 2026


التجديد التنظيمي لليسار في العصر الرقمي، مقترحات لتطوير مسودة النظام الداخلي للحزب الشيوعي العراقي


المطروحة للنقاش ضمن وثائق المؤتمر الوطني الثاني عشر


رزكار عقراوي


ملخص النص، لمن يود الاطلاع على النقاط الأساسية


كيف ندير الحزب اليوم يعكس كيف سندير المجتمع غدا


أنطلق في هذا النص من قناعة بأن الحزب اليساري صورة مصغرة للمجتمع الذي يسعى إلى بنائه وإدارته، وأن نظامه الداخلي يعكس بصورة مبكرة شكل الإدارة التي سيقدمها إذا تولى القيادة في الدولة. فالطريقة التي تتخذ بها القرارات داخل الحزب، وموقع القاعدة فيها، وحدود صلاحيات القيادة، ومدى احترام الرأي المختلف وغيرها، كلها تقدم للجماهير إجابة عملية عن سؤال جوهري: هل تكون السلطة في المجتمع الذي ننشده بيد الجماهير نفسها وتحت رقابتها المستمرة، أم تتركز في يد هيئات محدودة مهما حسنت نواياها؟ ومن هنا تأتي أهمية أن يجسد النظام الداخلي منذ اليوم قيم الديمقراطية والمشاركة والشفافية والتداول التي نعد بها المجتمع غدا.


أقدم هذه المقترحات وفق مفاهيم اليسار الرقمي، وأعني بها تطوير اليسار فكريا وتجديد آلياته التنظيمية استنادا إلى الأفكار والتجارب اليسارية المختلفة، وعلى أساس التطور المعرفي والحقوقي والثورة الرقمية معا.


ومن هذا المنطلق قرأت مسودة النظام الداخلي المطروحة للنقاش في الحزب الشيوعي العراقي قراءة رفاقية في خمسة عشر محورا، بدأتها بتسجيل ما هو متقدم في النص، وهو كثير ويستحق التقدير، ثم طرحت ملاحظاتي ومقترحاتي بهدف تطوير المسودة وإغنائها.


وأود التأكيد أن ما أطرحه هنا يتجاوز الحزب الشيوعي العراقي ليتصل بأحزاب اليسار وتنظيماته كافة، وبالأخص في بلدان الجنوب العالمي، حيث ما زال كثير من هذه التنظيمات يعيد إنتاج آليات تنظيمية صيغت في ظروف العمل السري والمطاردة تحت الأنظمة الديكتاتورية المستبدة. وقد خدمت تلك الآليات قوى اليسار في تلك الظروف، وقد تبقى بعض عناصرها ضرورية حيث ما زال القمع والاستبداد قائمين، غير أن كثيرا منها أصبح متقادما في الظروف الحالية وعاجزا عن مواكبة عصره.


كما أود التوضيح أن هذه القراءة والمقترحات تقتصر على الجانب التنظيمي، ولا تتناول سياسات الحزب وبرنامجه، التي يمكن أن نتفق أو نختلف معها في هذه النقطة أو تلك. فالظرف المعقد الذي يمر به العراق وعموم المنطقة يفسح المجال لاجتهادات يسارية متعددة، وهذا التنوع في الرؤى أمر طبيعي يعزز الطرح اليساري.


والمسألة في جوهرها أبعد من الشأن التنظيمي الإداري، فهي تتصل بقدرة اليسار على البقاء فاعلا. فالرأسمالية تجدد آليات عملها وتنظيمها على مدار الدقيقة، وتستثمر التطور في المجالات كافة لإعادة إنتاج هيمنتها وترسيخ سلطتها وتطوير مؤسساتها. ومن الصعب أن نواجه خصما يتجدد كل لحظة ببنى تنظيمية وأدوات لم تتطور بالشكل المناسب منذ عقود. ومن هنا تبرز الحاجة إلى أن نطور أنفسنا بوتيرة تواكب هذه التحولات، حتى يبقى اليسار حاضرا ومؤثرا في عصره.


ويقوم هذا التجديد على أربعة مرتكزات:


الأفكار والتجارب الاشتراكية المختلفة، السابقة منها والحالية، عبر قراءة نقدية منفتحة لها، تستفيد من إيجابياتها وإنجازاتها وتتعلم من نواقصها وإخفاقاتها، على الصعيدين الفكري والتنظيمي معا.


المعرفة، التي صارت متاحة ومفتوحة ولم تعد حكرا على مجموعة معينة تحتكر تفسير الواقع.


الوعي الحقوقي، الذي تقدم كثيرا في مسائل حق التعبير والرأي، والمساواة الكاملة للمرأة، وحقوق الإنسان والأقليات والبيئة والحريات الشخصية وغيرها.


الثورة الرقمية، التي أعادت تشكيل طريقة تواصل الناس وتنظيمهم وتعبيرهم عن آرائهم.


أما التنظيمات اليسارية التي تتأخر في تطوير آلياتها على ضوء هذه التجارب والتحولات الكبيرة، فقد تجد صعوبة متزايدة في التواصل مع الجماهير، وبالأخص الجيل الجديد، وفي أن تكون قريبة منها ومن اهتماماتها.


وتتوزع مقترحاتي على محاور مترابطة، أبرزها:


أن تكون القاعدة الحزبية مصدر السلطات، عبر عتبات عددية تتيح لها الدعوة إلى مؤتمر استثنائي أو مجلس حزبي عام أو استفتاء داخلي في القرارات المهمة، في اتجاه تحول تدريجي من البناء الهرمي إلى بناء أفقي.


تجديد القيادة بشكل دوري تداولي، والاتجاه نحو القيادة الجماعية بمنسقين ومنسقات في التخصصات المختلفة بدل تركيز الوظائف في موقع فردي، مع آلية لسحب الثقة بين مؤتمرين.


الاعتراف المنظم بتعدد المنابر والاتجاهات الفكرية داخل التنظيم بوصفه ضمانة للوحدة بدلا من أن يكون سببا للتفكك، وتطوير آليات الحوار وحرية التعبير …

author: Unknown
title: Resul Emrah Şahan: Herkesin sığabileceği bir siyaset lazım
content:
Tutuklu Şişli Belediye Başkanı Resul Emrah Şahan, sosyal medya hesabından yaptığı paylaşımda, “Sandıktan çıkan iradenin kapıda bekletilmediği, barışın bir vaat değil ortak bir gelecek olduğu, korkunun değil çokluğun konuştuğu bir siyaset lazım” dedi.

Bir sağa yürüyorum, bir sola. Eskiden başım dönerdi, şimdi dönmüyor.

Çünkü buradan baktığımda gördüğüm dört duvar değil, memleket.

Bir emekli, "onuru için" canına kıymış. Şişli'de gencecik bir çocuk hayatına son vermiş. Biri onurunu, öbürü geleceğini kaybettiğine yanan iki insan. İki kuşak, iki çaresizlik.

Tarihimizde görülmemiş ölçekte bir yolsuzlukla, fonlarla soyulmuş. Siyaset de bunun tam ortasında kalmış ama asıl soru sorulmamış. Bu sistem nasıl kurulmuş, nasıl ayakta kalmış? Üç beş isim gözden çıkarılmış, arınıyoruz denmiş. Sanki böyle hesap sorulurmuş gibi...

Bir milyondan fazla sosyal medya hesabı kapatılmış. Gazeteciler, sanatçılar… Herkes bir torbaya atılmış ve susturulmuş.

Bir de susturulmaya bile gerek kalmadan susanlar… Hepsi aynı cümleye sığınmış. “Ben yalnızca kentime hizmet peşindeyim…” Doğrusu, hizmet korkunun kılıfı olmuş.

Oysa “Başıma bir şey gelmesin” diye susan insan her gün biraz daha eksildiğinin farkına bile varmamış.

Önce seslerinden, sonra yüzlerinden, en sonunda da onları oraya taşıyan insanların güveninden olduklarının… Gençleri suskun, umutsuz, geleceksiz bıraktıklarının…

Susmayanlarsa tutsak. Onlarla birlikte milletin iradesi de.

Sandıktan çıkan umut, seçilmeyenlerin eline geçmiş. Onlar da o koltukları anasının ak sütü gibi helal saymış. Vekil olduklarını çoktan unutmuş, sırtlarını yasladıkları duvarların kendilerini o koltuklara sığdıracağına inanmış.

Ve hiçbir duvarın ardına sığmayan o umut: Barış…

Bu toprakların belki de en önemli eşiği. Yüz yıllık bir yaranın kapanabileceğine dair bir ihtimal.

Bu eşiği iç cephe, ortak gelecek sözleriyle oyalamak… Sakızcı Memo'yu duymamak… Kürt'ü yok sayıp Kürt adına konuşmak… Hâlâ barışa inanan insanların umudunu bir yönetme aracına dönüştürmek…

Bu memleket bu umutsuzluğa sığar mı? Görmüyor musunuz, onu taşıyanlar yorgun ama vazgeçmiş değil.

Şimdi Meclis açıldı. Bu milletin en yüce temsil evi kapılarını yeniden açtı.

Zamanımızın en önemli sürecinin raporu da orada duruyor.

Vekillerin, bütün siyasi partilerin imzasıyla millete verilmiş bir söz…

Siyaset ise hâlâ eski ezberlerin, eski kavgaların içinde çıkış arıyor.

Oysa camın öbür yanında kendine yer arayan koca bir kuşak bekliyor.

Peki camın iki yanı nasıl buluşacak? Dar ve eskimiş siyasetin ötesine nasıl geçeceğiz?

Belki önce bu memleketin hiçbirimizin tek başına taşıyamayacağı kadar büyük, hiçbirimizin dışında kalamayacağı kadar ortak olduğunu kabul ederek. Bu düzenin ne kadar çürüdüğünü söylemek artık yetmiyor çünkü. Çürüyeni anlatmak kolay. Mesele, yerine ne koyacağımızda.

Herkesin sığabileceği bir siyaset lazım bize.

Sandıktan çıkan iradenin kapıda bekletilmediği, gençlerin camı kırmadan içeri girebildiği, barışın bir vaat değil ortak bir gelecek olduğu, korkunun değil çokluğun konuştuğu bir siyaset.

Bu artık hepimiz için demokratik bir düzeni birlikte kurma meselesi. Ama böyle bir düzen kolay kurulmaz. Herkesin kendi mahallesinden, kendi partisinden, kendi ezberinden dışarı çıkmasını ister. Bize anlatılan her hikâyeye razı olmayan, sessizliği sağduyu sanmayan bir cesaret ister…

Kendi alanından çıkmaya korkanlar hâlâ aynı soruyu soruyor. Bu ülkenin çocuklarından, ortak geleceğinden önce ben ne olacağım, partim ne olacak…

Bilsinler ki tarih, bu ülke nefesini tutmuş beklerken siz neredeydiniz diye soracak.

Çünkü bu dönem hiçbir hesaba sığmayacak kadar ağır bir yük.

Ali'nin onurunun, Batuhan'ın yarım kalan hayatının, evlatlarımızın hasretinin, Meclis'e gelemeyen Can Atalay'ın, haksız yere tutuklu yargılanan seçilmişlerin ve bürokratların, barışın umuduyla bekleyen Kürt'ün, ortak gelecek sözüyle kandırılıp kandırılmadığını soran milyonların, ailelerimizin, küçük çocuklarımızın ve gerçekten ORTAK GELECEĞİMİZİN yükü…

Bu yük Meclis'in, bütün siyasetin, hepimizin omzunda.”

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

author: Unknown
title: EMEP’ten “iş cinayetleri” ve “fon vurgunu” eylemi: “Bu sömürü düzeninizi emekçiler başınıza yıkacak”
content:
İstanbul – Emek Partisi (EMEP) İstanbul İl Örgütü, bir yandan iş cinayetlerinin arttığını, diğer yandan ise patronların ve iktidarın fon vurgunuyla anıldığını belirtti, “cezasızlık” politikalarını eleştirdi. EMEP, Soma’daki İmbat Madencilik ocağında 5 madencinin yaşamını yitirmesiyle, fondan milyarlar kazanmanın aynı düzenin sonuçları olduğunu söyledi.

Bakırköy Meydanı’ndaki açıklamayı EMEP İl Yöneticisi Hazan İlik yaptı. Her fabrika, her şantiye, her iş yeri, her bir çalışma mahallinin işçiler için adeta bir mezarlığa dönüştürüldüğünü dile getiren İlik, ”Sadece 8 saatte en az 43 işçi iş kazası geçirdi. Bu 8 saatte Tuzla’da bir tersane işçisi parmağını kaybetti, Esenyurt’ta BİM deposunda çalışan bir işçi yaşamını yitirdi. Ve Soma’da İMBAT Madencilik’e ait ocakta 5 madenci daha yaşamını yitirdi” dedi.

Imbat Madencilikte bunun ilk kez yaşanmadığını vurgulayan İlik, “Eylül 2014'te Metin Keskin, vagon ile direk arasına sıkışarak yaşamını yitirdi. Ocak 2017'de İsmail Kahraman, gece vardiyasında kepçe altında ezilerek hayatını kaybetti. Ağustos 2019'de Selahattin Göktepe, bant temizlerken tambura sıkışarak can verdi. Nisan 2020'de bakım onarım çalışmaları sırasında 3 işçi öldü. Ekim 2022'de Durmuş Şahan, kömür dökümü yapan kepçenin altında kalarak can verdi. Bunca iş cinayetine sebep olmuş şirkette bugüne kadar ceza alan var mı? Hayır. İşçilerin kanıyla beslenerek Türkiye'nin En Büyük 500 Sanayi Kuruluşu listesinde yer alan Imbat Madencilik, tek kuruş kurumlar vergisi ödememiş. Yani ceza bir yana adeta ödüllendirilmiş” diye konuştu.

Dilovası’nda 3’ü çocuk 7 işçinin yanarak can verdiği katliamın davasında patronun pişkin pişkin “Binlerce kaza oluyor ama şirket sahiplerinin hiç yargılandığını görmedim” dediğini hatırlatan İlik şöyle devam etti: “İşte yaşadığımız Türkiye gerçeği budur. Emeğiyle geçinenlere insanlık dışı ücret, insanlık dışı çalışma koşulları ve insanlık dışı bir yaşam layık görülürken; sermaye, ucuzladıkça ucuzlayan iş gücünü yaşlı, çocuk, göçmen demeden “kullan-at” bir kalem olarak görüyor. İşçi sağlığı ve iş güvenliğini yalnızca bir maliyet unsuru olarak gören patronlar ve bu düzenin siyasi bekçiliğini yapan saray iktidarı, yarattığı kuralsızlıkla ve cezasızlık politikalarıyla bu ölümlerin baş sorumlusudur.”

İşçi Sağlığı ve İş Güvenliği (İSİG) Meclisinin raporuna göre ağustos ayında en az 226 işçinin iş cinayetlerinde hayatını kaybettiğini hatırlatan İlik, “Yılın ilk 8 ayında yaşamını yitiren işçi sayısı ise en az 1509’a ulaştı. Ağustosta ölenlerin 15’i çocuk, 15’i kadın, 16’sı göçmen işçiydi; yüzde 97’si sendikasızdı. Emeğimiz ucuzladıkça yaşamımızın değeri de ucuzluyor. Bir ülkede ücretler ne kadar düşükse, eğitim ve sağlık gibi kamusal haklar da o kadar gasbedilir. Emek ucuzsa, emeği güvence altına alan sendikal hak ve özgürlüklerin önünde ki engeller, baskı ve yasaklar da bir o kadar dizginsiz olur” dedi.

Bu düzenin kazananları olduğunu ifade eden İlik, “Ülkenin yeraltı ve yer üstü tüm kaynaklarına, emeğiyle geçinen milyonların kıt kanaat yaptığı birikimlere adeta birer akbaba gibi çöken saray oligarşisi ve etrafında kümelenen kayırmacı çıkar ağları, tam anlamıyla bir tahsilat çarkı kurmuş durumdadır. Bugün fon vurgunuyla ortalığa saçılan skandal, bu çarkın nasıl çalıştığını gözler önüne sermektedir. Saray iktidarı ilk günden beri AKP’li elitlerin mal varlıklarını koruma telaşına düşmüştür. AKP Genel Başkan Yardımcısı Hayati Yazıcı’nın oğlunun bile fon şüphelisi olarak listede yer aldığı, ancak bu tür isimlerin mal varlığı üzerindeki tedbirlerin nasıl buharlaştırıldığı ortadadır. Tıpkı borsada üç yılda yüzde 2000 büyüyen Astor Enerji'nin patronu Feridun Geçgel’in durumunda olduğu gibi; mal varlığına konulan tedbirler iktidar eliyle sadece birkaç saat içinde kaldırılabilmektedir. Fatma Betül Sayan Kaya’ya ise iddiaları reddetmemesine hatta görevinden istifa etmesine rağmen hala soruşturma bile açılmamıştır” dedi.

Tevfik Fikret’in dönemin asalaklarına seslendiği Yağma Sofrası’ndaki “Yiyin efendiler yiyin, bu han-ı iştiha sizin/Doyunca, tıksırınca, çatlayıncaya kadar yiyin” mısralarını hatırlatan İlik, “Bugün bu sofranın etrafında oturanlar, işçinin kanı üzerine zenginleşen patronlar ve bu düzenin bekçisi saray iktidarıdır. Fonlarda eriyen para da kamunun kasasındaki para da bordrodan kesilen vergi de işçilerin, emekçilerin alın terinden çıkıyor. Ancak biliyoruz ki ülkenin yönetilme şekline emekçiler müdahale etmedikçe, sermayenin ve sarayın bu saldırıları durdurulamaz. Bu vurgunun hesabını ne …

title: DEM Parti İmralı Heyeti, Yılmaz ve Kurtulmuş ile görüştü
content:
Halkların Eşitlik ve Demokrasi Partisi (DEM Parti) İmralı Heyeti üyeleri Pervin Buldan ve Mithat Sancar, Cumhurbaşkanı Yardımcısı Cevdet Yılmaz ile görüştü.

title: Bahçeli’den Fatma Betül Sayan Kaya yorumu: “İnsanın düştüğü çukur, kendi iradesinin tezahürüdür”
content:
MHP Genel Başkanı Devlet Bahçeli, “Her nerede ve kiminle ilgili olursa olsun, yolsuzluk, usulsüzlük, kamu malının istismarı, kuralların ihlali ve benzeri bir suç varsa, hukuk çerçevesinde suçun niteliğine, suç isnadının yöneltildiği kişinin kimliğine ve kişiliğine bakılmaksızın üzerine gidilmelidir” dedi.

MHP Genel Başkanı Devlet Bahçeli, yaptığı yazılı açıklamada, CHP'li belediyelere yönelik operasyonlar ile "fon vurgunu"na ilişkin değerlendirmelerde bulundu.

Son iki yıl içerisinde çok sayıda belediye hakkında rüşvet, irtikap, ihaleye fesat karıştırma ve örgütlü yolsuzluk iddialarıyla soruşturmalar yürütüldüğünü belirten Bahçeli, “Dava süreçleri devam etmekte olsa da soruşturmalara konu olan iddialar, ifadeler ve kamuoyuna yansıyan açıklamalar, olayların boyutunun büyük olduğunu ve ciddi biçimde ele alınmasını gerektirecek bir tabloyu ortaya koymaktadır. Esasen belediyeler, siyasi bir iktidar alanı olmaktan önce kamusal bir emanettir ve buraları yönetenlerin bu yasal ve ahlaki sorumluluğu içselleştirerek görevlerini yerine getirmeleri gerekmektedir. İhale, imar, ruhsat, taşınmaz, iştirak, personel ve kamu harcamaları gibi alanlarda oluşan her türlü çıkar ilişkisi, ceza hukukunu ilgilendiren bir problem olmanın yanında ahlak ve yönetişim problemidir” dedi.

Bahçeli, son günlerde yaşanan fon soruşturması kapsamındaki gelişmelere de değindi. “Bu tarihi yolsuzluk skandalının mali tablosunu kamuoyumuz merak etmektedir” diyen Bahçeli şöyle devam etti: “Yargı kararlarıyla, Sayıştay ve ilgili denetim kurumlarının tespitleriyle birlikte kamu zararının açıkça ortaya konulması, yolsuzlukların faturasının kamuoyunda paylaşılması, maşeri vicdanın rahatlatılması bakımından kaçınılmazdır. Yolsuzluklarla uğranılan kamu zararı geri alınarak emeklimize, dar ve sabit gelirli vatandaşlarımıza verilmeli, onların refahı için harcanmalıdır.”

İtirafların belediyelerde isteme ve çökme yoluyla, cebren açık bir yolsuzluk ve rüşvet çarkının söz konusu olduğunu gösterdiğini vurgulayan Bahçeli, “Fon piyasasındaki olaylar ise yapılan manipülasyonlar saklı olmak üzere isteğe bağlı bir tasarruftur. Burada yolsuzlukları yarıştırmaya yahut birini masumlaştırmaya çalışmıyorum. Bir gerçeğe dikkat çekerek, adı yeni, zihniyeti eski olan siyasilere, toplumu istismar etmeye, farklı bir yere yönlendirmeye, bu yolla da belediyelerinizde yapılan hukuksuzlukların üstünü örtmeye çalışmayın, bu hikayeye kimseyi inandıramazsınız demek istiyorum” dedi.

Bahçeli şunları söyledi: “Halkın emek ve alın terinin hülasası olan devlet mülkünü omuzlarda taşımak büyük bir sorumluluktur. Devlet mülküne tasallut edenin adaletle terbiyesi ise devlet ahlakındadır. Elbette insanın düştüğü çukur, kendi iradesinin tezahürüdür. Bu iradeyi bir değere, inanca, fikre ve zümreye bağlamak, sorunun tespitini güçleştireceği gibi yanlış teşhis üzerinden tedaviyi de işlevsiz kılabilecektir. Ahlaki temelleri çürük olan devletin adalet çatısı da çökmüş olacaktır. Devletin ahlakını oluşturan adalet ise her bir insanın hakkının teminat altına alınması ve gözetilmesidir. Her nerede ve kiminle ilgili olursa olsun, yolsuzluk, usulsüzlük, kamu malının istismarı, kuralların ihlali ve benzeri bir suç varsa, hukuk çerçevesinde suçun niteliğine, suç isnadının yöneltildiği kişinin kimliğine ve kişiliğine bakılmaksızın üzerine gidilmelidir. Bu anlayış çerçevesinde, ahlak, adalet, liyakat, hakkaniyet ve hesap verebilirlik çerçevesinde 'temiz siyaset, temiz yönetim ve müreffeh toplum' hedefinin somut bir zihniyet ve ahlaki reform programına dönüştürülmesi sağlanmalıdır.”

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

author: Mark Weisbrot
title: In Brazil’s Elections, Trump Seeks to Tighten Right Wing Grip on the Americas
content:
The US has been heavily intervening on behalf of right wing challenger Flávio Bolsonaro ahead of Sunday’s elections.

Did you know that Truthout is a nonprofit and independently funded by readers like you? If you value what we do, please support our work with a donation.

One of the most important elections in recent Latin American history will take place Sunday in Brazil. Incumbent president Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva has recently been emphasizing the issue of national sovereignty. One reason: The challenger, Flávio Bolsonaro, has the strong backing of the Trump administration — and the US has been intervening heavily on his behalf.

In the past few months of Brazil’s election campaign, Trump has met with Bolsonaro at the White House, imposed new tariffs on Brazilian goods, and tried to send State Department officials to Brazil. (Both Brazilian and American officials said the presence of Trump administration operatives would cast doubt on the integrity of the voting there.)

A letter last week to Secretary of State Marco Rubio from 31 members of Congress documented additional hostile actions and concluded that “the United States is acting as an agent of interference and destabilization.”

The election is forecast to be very close, and the sovereignty issue could be persuasive for swing voters.

Trump’s intervention undermines a basic and generally cherished right to self-determination, as well as the right to democracy itself. It is even clearly illegal under the Charter of the Organization of American States, to which the United States is a signatory.

But Brazilians currently have reasons to attach even more urgency to preserving their sovereignty and independence. This can be seen in the recent history of Brazil and Latin America and in the economic impact of political independence on living standards.

Starting with Brazil: Lula was a metalworker and union leader who helped found, and then lead, the Workers Party. He served two consecutive terms as president of Brazil from 2003 to 2010 and left office with one of the highest approval ratings in the world — 83 percent.

There were compelling reasons for that, which stemmed from the government’s changes in economic and social policy. These changed the lives of tens of millions of people in Brazil. GDP per person, the most basic measure of living standards, grew about four times as fast as it did in the eight years prior to Lula’s presidency. Poverty was reduced by 61 percent and extreme poverty by 64 percent. There was also a 57 percent increase in the real (inflation-adjusted) minimum wage. University enrollment almost doubled.

Lula was able to implement these and other life-changing reforms because he broke with the “Washington Consensus” policies that had governed economic decision-making in the region as perhaps never before, from 1980 to 2000. This included economic policies that were often decided at the International Monetary Fund or sometimes other Washington-controlled institutions. The result was a disaster: Those two decades saw the worst long-term economic growth failure in Latin America for more than 100 years.

This historic economic growth collapse helped bring about the election of left-of-center governments in the majority of the region for the first time. As in Brazil, these governments were more independent than the prior regional norm and therefore pursued more progressive and effective economic policies. The turnaround was historic: From 2002 to 2013, the percentage of the population of Latin America living in poverty fell to 28.4 from 45.6 after increasing over the prior two decades.

The independence that these governments were able to establish is what Rubio and Trump appear to most want to abolish. Hence their current efforts at regime change in Brazil. This is the big prize for Rubio. It’s the largest country in Latin America, and a Lula government won’t support the Trump administration in its illegal efforts to control the region. But Lula’s opponent would almost certainly be a solid Trump ally.

That is Flávio Bolsonaro, a senator hand-picked by his father Jair Bolsonaro, who was president from 2019 to 2023; he has branded himself “Bolsonaro 2.0.”

Flávio and his team are trying to link Lula to the biggest bank fraud in Brazilian history, which forced a deposit insurance payout of almost $8 billion for about 800,000 victims. But the dirt is actually on Flávio and his allies. He is up to his neck in this scandal. Nothing on Lula …

author: Sasha Abramsky
title: Trump’s “Drill, Baby, Drill” Regime Is Now Targeting California’s Coastline
content:
The US Commerce Secretary is bullying California with an audit that could strip the state of control over its own coast.

Support justice-driven, accurate and transparent news — make a quick donation to Truthout today!

Earlier this year, as the Trump administration ramped up pressure on California to agree to increased oil and natural gas drilling permits up and down the Pacific Coast, Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick took to the social media platform X to berate the California Coastal Commission, and the Coastal Zone Management Act’s system for maintaining the coast in line with California regulations, for its “obstructionist” and extreme environmental tendencies.

In an unprecedented move, Lutnick ordered the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration’s auditors — who are in charge of reviewing the regulatory systems of each of the more than 30 coastal and Great Lakes states — to conduct a new audit.

This summer, after a series of in-person and Zoom hearings in which the public expressed overwhelming opposition to increased offshore drilling, it became clear that Lutnick’s audit is intended to reach a predetermined conclusion: that California’s coastal management system — which has been in place since the Nixon era and has successfully interacted during that time with the federal government via the Coastal Zone Management Act — should be defunded to the tune of millions of dollars annually and decertified. It appears that ultimately Lutnick’s audit aims, for the first time in history, to strip states of their right to control their own coastlines.

What made Lutnick’s move even more shameful was that in 2024 the NOAA had completed an audit of the California Coastal Commission and had, according to those who saw the 2025 draft of its findings, given it the equivalent of an A+, praising its work and only finding two minor areas in which it sought improvements.

“If the administration wants to reopen pipelines or do oil and gas drilling off the coast of California, it has been the coastal commission that has been able to ensure environmental safeguards,” a former federal official in the Department of Commerce, who asked to remain anonymous due to concerns about retribution being aimed at them and their colleagues who are still with the federal government, told Truthout. In other words, California was doing its job and doing it well.

It appears that ultimately Lutnick’s audit aims, for the first time in history, to strip states of their right to control their own coastlines.

When the Trump administration took power in 2025, however, it put the kibosh on the report and refused to allow its release. Earlier this year, the administration invoked the Defense Production Act to do an end-run around California’s opposition to the reopening of the Sable oil pipeline, off of the Santa Barbara coast, which had ruptured in 2015 and caused an environmental catastrophe.

Now — through attempting to neutralize the California Coastal Commission, and subsidiary organizations such as the Bay Conservation and Development Commission for the waters in the San Francisco Bay — the Trump administration is ramping up pressure on the state to conform to its new “drill, baby, drill” fossil fuel energy priorities and to the administration’s efforts to turn SpaceX, which has launching sites in California, some of which have run into opposition from the coastal commission, into a space-age industrial superpower.

For weeks now, California’s political leaders have been sounding the alarm about what they deem to be the biggest threat to the state’s fabled coastline, and the more than $50 billion that, according to the California Coastal Commission, the coastal tourism economy contributes to California, since high-profile oil spills in the late 1960s tipped the state away from oil development.

Alliances of coastal businesses have gotten involved, horrified at the thought that by mid-2027 there could be an oil and gas rush in California.

Alliances of coastal businesses, wary that ecological damage will impact their bottom line, have also gotten involved, horrified at the thought that by mid-2027 there could be an oil and gas rush in California, and that with that rush will, inevitably, come spills that foul the waters and beaches of the Golden State.
